notes.title: Huge Roguelike Update
notes.content:
[h2]Roguelike[/h2]
[u]New 6 arenas[/u] were added making the total number of arenas 11!
Now [u]every level[/u] transition gives you [u]3 [b]infusions[/b][/u] to choose from!

[h2]Infusions[/h2]
3 New infusions have been added to the game
[list]
[*] [b]Lightning[/b] - bounces between 3 targets dealing damage and restoring inspiration(mana)
[*] [b]Fire[/b] - Deals damage 5 times a second and disappears after 2 seconds if not reapplied
[*] [b]Nails[/b] - every attack with this infusion stacks dealing progressively more damage 
[/list]
All of them have their unique Titles on the screen when applied to the enemy
Also, titles are appearing now when applying [b]Muerte[/b]

[h2]Combat and Balance[/h2]
The new mechanic added - [b]Heartbreak[/b]
If you drain all [u]poise[/u] out of the enemy he will explode spawning a healing item

All enemies got +100 health due to increased damage from infusions
All infusions have been rebalanced to make their new levels more impactful

[u]Charge attacks[/u] are now parts of the character's basic kit and [u]do not require a Skull Trait[/u]

New skull traits have been added - [b]Double Dash[/b]

Dash cooldown has been increased to 2 seconds

[h2]Visual upgrades[/h2]

Now enemy attacks start with 2 red lines coming together to make it easier to recognize it

[u]Now invincibility frames are visualized by the phantoms of Jane[/u]. You can see it by acquiring Invincibilty Dash as Skull Trait

[h3]Near Future[/h3]

If you follow Reddit, Twitter, or Bluesky you might be confused where is other things that I've been working on such as
[olist]
[*] New Biome
[*] Weapon system
[*] Active ability system
[*] New attacks with bombs and swings for enemies
[/olist]

All that has been in the works but a week ago I realised that I need more time to flesh all that
So instead I did all that is in this update last week since it was quicker to make

I felt really bad without making an update till Christmas so here is my present for you:3

There will be one more update this year, I will not promise anything in particular but foot sounds

[h1]Merry-merry Christmas:3[/h1]

notes.title: Progression System Update
notes.content:
[h1]Traits[/h1]
Now there are 6 different traits to choose from:
✨Invulnerability frames on the dash
✨Charged attacks
✨Each kill increases the max hp by 1
✨Each candy increases the maximum poise
✨ Each blow fills up the poise
✨ The damage received can be immediately replenished by attacking in response

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177599/512da81b057213440faf27c15c572232cd50683b.png[/img]

You can interact with this Skull guy in the hub to change traits. You can choose how many traits to activate as you have skulls, you're starting with 1 skull, and Charge attacks activated

Here you can also buy skulls, but every new one will have a higher price

Activating and Deactivating don't cost anything so you are fully enabled to change your traits and tactics between runs^^

[h1]Quality of life[/h1]

✨Every UI fully navigable with a gamepad
✨Fixed bag with bone trader not giving bones in exchange for candies
✨now traders have a candy icon instead of the letter C on the pricetag
✨If you have enough candies to buy an upgrade then the commodity model will be higher than I trader signalizing to you that he is around and waiting
✨All dual pistol animation got updated to higher quality and smoothness
✨Graphical settings update their status between levels (previously it would say "best" no matter what)

[h1]Future[/h1]

I'm planning on adding
✨Achivements
✨Weapons
✨Biome
✨New Enemies
✨Boss
✨Quality Of Life Improvements

with new updates^^
I'm not sure whether or not all of these features will be included in the next update, but there will be an update one week after with at least some of those features included. 
For next 2 months i want to update at least once a week to keep it growing

Feel free to give me suggestions and just speak your mind on how game is right now^^

notes.title: Halloween Costume Update!
notes.content:
[i]Costume system[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177599/fdd7615c0f64768b85e1e7bd6d5d8f65a29f70c4.png[/img]

3 new Costumes have been added!
You can buy them with bones that I hope you'll already collected plenty^^

2 ways to get bones:
[list]
[*]You can buy them in a shop exchanging candies for bones
[*]When you die your candies convert to bones 4 to 1(so make sure to buy bones when you can)
[/list]

In the future, there will be specific traits to the costume but for now, they are motivators to play more, like a little milestone and a way to refresh the experience with a shiny new costume^^

[i]Dual Pistols[/i]

By watching different gamers play I notice how nobody likes to use the attack on the right mouse button
So I changed this attack to a dual pistol combo that is very nice to tap into

Pistols deal little damage but deal more damage to posture (yellow bar on enemies)

They also get their infusions that you can get in a run

[i]Charge Attacks[/i]
To make combat more stylish and interesting I decided to bring charge attacks 
If you hold the attack button (left or right mouse button) then you will perform a unique animation depending on your weapon

[i]Other[/i]
[list]
[*]Parry has been buffed by spawning an explosion that deals damage around the player
[*]Shops now have bigger icons when you are far away from them and have enough candy for them
[*]New icons to Infused Dash and Jump
[*]Little animation for HUD when opening level
[*]Chrono stun is cycled out from the infusion pool since it made parrying so much harder
[/list]

[b]Future plans[/b]
I'm ecstatic about the game and the reception! Fired up to work more
Sadly my productivity has been low and I was figuring out the way to move forward here is a short-term plan

The next update will address criticisms of quality of life. I will work on the settings menu, and bugs and make the overall UI more user-friendly, Steam Achievements, better Controller support
I hope to push it ASAP

After that there will be an update with a better progression system - I planned to make it with costumes and even got decent progress. So there is half of it done

Longterm 

For now, Roguelike will be the top priority moving forward
I want to make the ultimate Roguelike experience with completely different biomes to choose from, an innovative progression system, a bunch of weapons, infusions, and active abilities
The goal is to make players choose in which order to go through biomes giving incentives to do that with different build

After Roguelike is polished I want to go through the story content

...

Thank you so much for being here with me! It's only the start of the journey and I full-heartedly hope that you having a lot of fun playing it^^

Make sure to raise your concerns on Discord, steam discussions, and even direct in my dms on Twitter

bye bye bye and Stay STYLISH
